hook: A *₹90* change dispute on a bus cost a conductor her life
hook_b: A *₹90* change dispute on a bus cost a conductor her life
tldr: TGSRTC conductor Pravalika died about 10 days after being pushed from a moving bus near Mittagudem.

beats.what: Pravalika, a Manuguru-depot conductor, was allegedly pushed off a moving bus on Oct 25 after a row over ₹90 balance. She died about 10 days later.
beats.why: Cash change disputes on buses are routine; this one ended in a death. A woman passenger was taken into custody and a case registered on RTC's complaint.
beats.care: Carry small change or pay digitally. Raise fare issues with the depot, not on the footboard.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Transport minister Ponnam Prabhakar assured strict action; CM Revanth Reddy condoled her death and assured support (Deccan Chronicle, The Hans India).

cards.q: What would protect bus conductors most?

twist: The passenger paid ₹100 for a half ticket; the ₹10 ticket carried a note of the ₹90 balance owed.
